title: Aaradhane
desc: A priest performs sacred rituals and chants hymns, seeking blessings from the deity. The ceremony brings peace and devotion to all who witness it.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Hombisilu
desc: Dr Vishnuvardhan desperately wants an assistant and meets Arati who is also a doctor. She falls in love with him and they get married.

title: Mugulu Nage
desc: Pulakeshi is romantically involved with three women at different points in his life, which teaches him the meaning of love.

title: Identity
desc: Stranded at a desolate motel during a nasty rainstorm, ten strangers become acquainted with each other. However, they soon realise that they are being killed off one by one.

title: Victory
desc: The daughter of a farmer is determined to become an international cricketer despite facing numerous challenges to make her father feel content.

title: Dude
desc: Agan and Kural, lifelong friends, face a turning point when the latter suffers a heartbreak. Subsequently, Agan must decide whether to confess his secret love or keep his feelings hidden.

title: Golmal Part II
desc: In a bid to earn more money, Radhakrishna, a married man, pretends to be the husband of Meera, a wealthy woman. However, complications arise when Krishna's wife discovers their strange arrangement.
